reason: flow:f_o_t7_to_s_amp: The arrow and DNA-labeled endpoint are faithfully recorded, and the candidate does not assert direct DNA synthesis by T7 polymerase. However, this material-output interface remains consequentially unresolved: catalogue-described IVT and the drawn DNA endpoint do not establish the same immediate carrier. Obtain the scAba-Seq methods or primary amplification/library figure for PMID 27347753, determine what the DNA label represents, and record the evidence-supported interpretation or correction while preserving the drawn route. The supplied abstract cannot resolve it.; operation:o_t7: The named block and its pooled DNA input are supported. Its final output cannot yet receive a positive scientific check: the catalogue specifies T7-mediated IVT, whereas the diagram ends in DNA, and the target abstract contains no amplification-to-library interface. The candidate correctly distinguishes depiction from its RNA interpretation, but that qualification does not establish whether o_t7 is IVT alone, a compressed route ending in DNA, or an imprecisely labeled schematic. Research the target implementation to resolve that exact interface; routine conditions and quantities are unnecessary.; record: All depicted upstream transformations, the adaptor component, the genuine pooling interface, the one target method, and all listed reference associations are represented without importing background assays or commercial kits. Full positive review remains pending only on the final material interface: o_t7 -> s_amp / f_o_t7_to_s_amp is DNA-labeled in the diagram but IVT-described in the catalogue. Because this affects the identity of the amplified/readout carrier, u_t7_product cannot currently be treated as nonblocking for the complete requested architecture. Obtain primary scAba-Seq amplification/library evidence and resolve that distinction without inventing an unshown recipe.; state:s_amp: The DNA label, multiple blue strokes, and lack of colored tags are faithfully preserved, and the candidate does not infer tag removal. Its general per-cell 5hmC interpretation is supported. The physical endpoint nonetheless remains unresolved: an interpreted immediate RNA product and the depicted DNA endpoint are combined in one broad state without primary evidence establishing their relationship. Research whether the endpoint represents RNA, an eventual DNA library after a compressed conversion, or a schematic labeling error; then retain the drawn label and separately record the supported resolution.; unknown:u_t7_product: The question accurately identifies the source conflict and the missing evidence, but its blocking=false assessment is not justified for a completed material-level review. Final carrier identity and the relationship between IVT and the DNA-labeled endpoint are consequential to o_t7, s_amp, and f_o_t7_to_s_amp. Primary methods or a primary figure/caption from the declared scAba-Seq implementation must establish the immediate amplification prod

candidate.title: scAba-Seq
candidate.scope: The single Illumina scAba-Seq schematic: single-cell genomic 5hmC is glucosylated with T4-βGT, recognized through AbaSI digestion, represented by cell-indexed adaptor-ligated DNA fragments, pooled after indexing, and passed through the depicted T7 amplification block. scABA-seq in the catalogue and scAba-seq in the image are capitalization variants of this target. Other-cell ligated DNA enters at the explicit pooling boundary; its separate upstream workflows are not drawn. The final DNA label is retained alongside the catalogue-described T7-IVT interpretation, without inventing an unshown conversion or complete sequencing recipe. SCL-exo, the Sun PvuRts1I/enrichment assay, and the listed commercial kits are not additional schematic targets.
